matter_background.original: Ranjith Silva commenced building a Condominium with ten apartments, in his property situated in Rajagiriya in 2016. He entered into 10 Sale and Purchase Agreements with 10 prospective buyers to sell these apartments ranging from Rs. 28 million upwards. The apartment was completed in 2018.
